Title: Any Layer Trash
Description: Delete shapes on any layer without dragging them down to layer 1 first. With this mod, placing a Trash building automatically fills every layer of that tile with trash, and deleting any one clears the whole column — as a single undoable action that also works with area-drag, blueprints, and platform deletes. Layers already occupied by other buildings are skipped, and only plain vanilla trash is placed, so nothing mod-specific is written to your save (remove the mod any time and your trash stays as ordinary trash).
Author: Dork
